## Rules

- Sessions expire. No infinite tokens.
- Refresh tokens stored server-side and invalidated on use (rotation).
- Access tokens short-lived (<1h). Refresh tokens long-lived but revocable.
- Failed auth attempts: log the attempt (timestamp, IP, username) — never log the password.
- Password resets: time-limited single-use tokens. Invalidate immediately after use.
- Use established libraries (e.g. bcrypt, PyJWT, passport). Never custom crypto.
